profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at National Domestic Workers Alliance
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Studying astronomy and physics I became interested in how some of the biggest problems in these fields are being solved in such creative ways given the limited information we can observe. From quantum physics to detecting exoplanets, computational and mathematical applications to  these problems has become increasingly useful and necessary. As I learn about these distinct fields themselves I find myself making more connections and gaining a unified knowledge and skill-set. Part of what appeals to me about these problems is the combination of both creativity and logic to solve these problems. Finding solutions to issues and questions, for which our information is highly limited, requires innovative creativity which develops as you pursue your task.
I am driven by this multidisciplinary challenge because of what I believe is the power in combining strong conceptual knowledge with efficient application. I am also motivated when working in groups having been in both leadership and non-leadership positions because I know how powerful a well working group can be; Nevertheless, I am also focused and organized enough to work on my own. Fundamentally I am driven by the spirit of research and discovery which many of the most notable researchers and academics in the fields of mathematics and science have inspired in me.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading AI engineering efforts on Aya, NDWA's digital personal assistant powered by AI and the collective wisdom of thousands of domestic and care workers. Established evaluation and improvement flywheel for development on features to support coaching, and personalized guidance to help with domestic workplace challenges.

positions.title: Community Interpreter
positions.description: Simultaneous interpretation for speaker panels, community events, and grassroots organizations. Interpreted for international public officials, university scholars, and activists.

positions.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: Developed and managed content recommendations which drove 40% improvement in SEO metrics. Implemented a real-time activity feed.

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: Developing and researching statistical and machine learning models for natural language processing (NLP) of extensive education related user generated content to generate interactive educational products and experiences. Leaning on full-stack experience to develop functional prototypes and demos.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Upgraded and developed core content platforms and technology from acquired company. Worked in a full stack capacity developing React, Django apps for content publishing and editing.  Oversaw data transfer and data documentation between different cloud operators. Played role as expert on Slader.com's data models and data architecture. Worked on sunsetting portions of Slader.com and migrating 20 Million+ user base over to Quizlet.

positions.title: Co-Founder / Worker Owner / Web Designer
positions.description: Web Designer at Algarabia Language Co-op LLC  updating class schedules, managing the development and growth of AlgarabiaLanguage.com.

positions.title: Data Scientist / Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Team leader in developing algorithms and performing scientific analysis on big data.  Charged with implementing algorithms, and understanding and interpreting various functions of the Slader eco-system from the ad-stack to the user experience and content strategy. Improved and developed  analytical tools including OCR tools, ML models, and analytics dashboards that have driven SEO and content strategy.
Acquired by Quizlet in August 2020

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description: Tasked with developing and implementing computational statistical methods, research tools, and data visualizations using various programming languages for real time motion tracking system in 10,000 Sq. Ft. event space. Authored and presented paper accepted to International Educational Data Mining Conference. Submitted additional papers to related conferences. Performed web analytics by data mining log data and developed user behavior models. Used sketch up 3D modeling to design component for installation of motion tracking system. Led professional development and informational presentations on data mining topics and ethical privacy issues.

positions.title: Legal Assistant Paralegal
positions.description: Organized and tracked an extensive set of patent cases and patent applications. Filed Patent Cooperation Treaty applications and reported through letters the grants of foreign patents to enterprises. Managed deadlines and communicated with clients through letters.

positions.title: Audio Video Technical Support
positions.description: Worked for the Columbia Scholastic Press Association Student Conference assisting over 100 presenters with A/V technical support for a student conference.

positions.description: Led and mentored a group of 15 high school students through a 6 month STEM enrichment program and created content on topics to help through career choices and college admissions. Worked through two program cycles

volunteerExperiences.description: Organized 6 month long enrichment for a group of 4 high school students culminating in a STEM project which seeks to create a positive social, environmental, or health impact in the community. Weekly volunteering at after school program in Harlem NYC helping young students learn to read.
